senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; אָיַב, √או or אב, cmp. אַבְאָבִית, אָוֶן, עָוֹן)enmity, hostility, grudge.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:5">Snh. III, 5</cite> an enemy is he who has not spoken to his neighbor for three days <he>בא׳</he> in his grudge; a. fr.—<he>משום</he> (<he>מפני</he>) <he>א׳</he> for the sake of preventing ill-feeling.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 4:1:6">Y. Dem. IV, 24ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:1:12">Y. Yoma VIII, 44ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>הכלה מפני א׳</he> the bride (is permitted to wash her face on the Day of Atone.) that she may not lose her attraction.
